name_en: Mazegohan — chicken, burdock, and shiitake simmered sweet-savory and folded into hot rice
summary_ja: 鶏肉やごぼう、干ししいたけなどを細かく刻んで醤油と砂糖で炒め煮し、炊き立てのごはんに混ぜ込む具飯。嘉島町の六嘉神社の秋の例大祭では、鶏肉の代わりに馬肉を使う家庭もあるという。
summary_en: Chicken, burdock, and dried shiitake are cut fine, simmered sweet in soy, and folded into freshly cooked rice. At the autumn festival of Rokka Shrine in Kashima, some households are said to use horse meat instead of chicken.

name_en: Amakusa tako meshi — rice cooked or mixed with rehydrated sun-dried octopus
summary_ja: 天日干しにした「干しダコ」を水でもどして刻み、ごぼうや人参と炊き込む、または後から混ぜるご飯。旨味が凝縮した干しダコを使うことが多く、天草市有明町の夏の風物詩とされる干しダコ干しの光景で知られる。
summary_en: Sun-dried octopus is rehydrated, chopped, and either cooked into rice with burdock and carrot or mixed in afterward — a dish that leans on the concentrated flavor of dried octopus, known for the summer sight of octopus hung out to dry in Amakusa's Ariake.
